subject: Reserve capacity triage — upcoming close windows & prioritization
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Reserve capacity triage — upcoming close windows & prioritization

Team —

Quick heads-up ahead of today's weekly fleet planning: ACME accelerated their EPD and now expects a signed PO around the week of Mar 8–12. Sales forecast shows a 70% probability but finance is asking for a reserve commit to support the initial production ramp.

High-level ask from Sales/Customer:
- Reserve 24 A100-80GB equivalents (estimate attached model) for a 6–12 month commitment starting Mar 15.
- Support burst capacity for first 6 weeks (estimated 30% extra).

Attachments: reserve_request_modeling.xlsx (demand curve + concurrency), mutual_action_plan.pdf (draft).

Please confirm infra feasibility (Karthik), pricing/discount runway (Ben), and whether product ops has objections on rollout timing (Marissa).

Goal for today's sync: agree queue/priority for March pool allocations and an initial commit term to propose to ACME.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett 
Sr. Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserve capacity triage — upcoming close windows & prioritization

On 2027-02-07 08:12, Laura Bennett wrote:
> Team —
>
> Quick heads-up ahead of today's weekly fleet planning: ACME accelerated their EPD...

Thanks Laura — reviewed the attachment quickly. A few infra notes:
- 24x A100-80GB reserved is doable but will consume a big share of our Q2 reserved pool in us-west.
- We can offer a split: 18 reserved + 6 burst-on-demand credits. That keeps pool flexibility for other near-term closes.
- Autoscaling cooldowns + batch concurrency tuning can reduce sustained reservation needs by ~15% per modeling (I'll validate offline).

Risks: if we lock 24 reserved for 12 months, we lose the ability to reassign for higher priority deals in Mar–Apr. Recommend an initial 6-month commit with a predefined break clause tied to customer usage metrics (e.g., sustained 60% utilization for 8 weeks).

Actionable items for infra:
- I'll run a safety margin check and map which physical hosts these reservations would land on and report back before 3pm PT.
- If Sales wants hard guarantees for latency SLOs, we need to pair reserved capacity with prioritized routing (minor config change).

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserve capacity triage — upcoming close windows & prioritization

Thanks — conservative approach makes sense. A few finance items:
- For a 6-month commit of 18 reserved + 6 burst credits, we can offer a 12% list discount with a revenue recognition schedule front-loaded to month 1 (helps ARR during the quarter).
- If ACME signs a 12-month firm commit for 24 reserved, we can extend to 18% discount plus a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to ~10% of first-month usage).
- Need confirmed deal_id and MSLA exceptions if they require additional uptime SLAs.

Sarah / Procurement — can you confirm if ACME has constraints on commit length? Laura, can you confirm the target AC (close) date?

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudpartner.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserve capacity triage — upcoming close windows & prioritization

Laura / team —

Thanks for the quick follow-ups. From ACME's side:
- We are aiming to finalize commercial terms by Mar 10. Engineering expects production cutover by Mar 22.
- Preferred commit would be 12 months, but procurement will accept a 6-month starting term with an option to extend after month 4 pending utilization.
- Latency SLOs: we need p95 < 150ms for the first 3 months; after that, standard contract SLOs are fine.

Procurement has uploaded a short checklist to the shared drive (see link). Rajiv from CloudPartner is looped for networking connectivity questions.

Happy to proceed with the 18+6 split as an interim proposal if that helps speed the PO.

—Sarah
Sarah Chen
VP, Platform Engineering
ACME Corp

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserve capacity triage — upcoming close windows & prioritization

Great thread — thanks everyone. Quick summary & owners: 

Decisions:
- Move forward with an interim proposal of 18 reserved A100-80GB + 6 burst credits for the initial 6 months.
- Include a utilization-triggered extension option at month 4 and an option to convert to a 12-month reserve for a higher discount.

Owners / next steps: 
- Karthik: deliver infra mapping + safety margin by EOD (assigned).
- Ben: prepare pricing template and two offer rows (6mo/12mo) with discount tiers by EOD 2/8.
- Laura: update mutual action plan & push interim proposal to ACME; confirm final close date and ask Procurement for any contract redlines.
- Marissa: flag the rollout plan in next week's product-release window; note any migration constraints.

I'll present this as the Fleet Planning ask in today's sync — please be ready to escalate if infra mapping shows >20% impact to Q2 reserved capacity.

Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
